title: Projects dashboard redesign (GENESIS.ENGINE style) with preserved project actions

requirements.summary: Fully redesign the Projects dashboard layout and project tiles to match the GENESIS.ENGINE reference while preserving create/open/edit/delete behaviors.
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard route/view still shows the list of projects and supports: create project, open project, edit project settings, and delete project (same callbacks/behavior as before).
The page header/hero area visually matches the reference: large typographic wordmark treatment, subdued supporting copy, and an overall dark, minimal, high-contrast aesthetic.
Project cards are redesigned to match the reference card style: large rounded tiles, subtle borders/shadows, subdued secondary text, and hover-driven emphasis.

A dedicated 'Start new project' tile exists in the grid as a dashed-outline/placeholder style tile with a centered plus icon and label similar to the reference, and triggers the existing create-project dialog when clicked.

Card content matches the reference’s intent by showing key project fields in the card (at minimum: blockchain/protocol tag, project name, unit count/collection size, and an initialized/created date derived from createdAt).
Per-card actions for settings/edit and delete remain available and do not trigger open-project when clicked (stopPropagation preserved).
Animations/interactions are updated to match the reference’s flow: subtle fade/scale in on load and a clear hover state on tiles without harming performance or accessibility.
All user-facing strings introduced/modified by this redesign are in English.

file_operations.description: Replace the current dashboard layout with a GENESIS.ENGINE-style hero and grid, rework project rendering to use a clickable tile/card (open on tile click), include a dedicated dashed 'Start new project' tile that opens the existing create dialog, and show required project fields (blockchain tag, name, collection size, initialized date derived from createdAt) while preserving the existing callbacks (onCreateProject/onOpenProject/onUpdateProject/onDeleteProject). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Dialog, Button) for structure and interactions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable project tile component to match the reference card style (large rounded tile, subtle border/shadow, subdued secondary text, clear hover emphasis) and to safely host per-tile actions (settings/delete) that stopPropagation so tile click still opens the project. Use shadcn-ui Button for icon actions and consistent focus/keyboard states; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a dedicated dashed-outline 'Start new project' tile component with centered plus icon/label that triggers the existing create-project dialog open state. Ensure keyboard accessibility (button semantics) and reference-like hover feedback. Use shadcn-ui Button (or button semantics) for consistent focus styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add minimal global utility classes to support the reference dashboard visuals and interactions (e.g., wordmark/hero typography treatment, tile hover glow/border emphasis, subtle fade/scale-in variants) while respecting prefers-reduced-motion behavior already defined.

requirements.summary: Restyle the create-project and project-settings dialogs to match the redesigned dashboard aesthetic without changing validation logic or data shape.
acceptanceCriteria: The New Project dialog still creates a project with the same fields and defaults as before and navigates into the project as before.
The Project settings dialog still edits name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode as before.
Dialog styling (background, borders, typography, spacing, control shapes) is consistent with the redesigned dashboard and uses existing shadcn components (composed, not modified in-place).

file_operations.description: Extract the New Project dialog into a dedicated component that preserves the existing field set, defaults, and submit handler behavior, while updating styling to the new dark/minimal/rounded look by composing existing shadcn-ui Dialog, Input, Label, Switch, and Button components (do not modify shadcn components in-place). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extract the Project Settings dialog into a dedicated component that preserves the existing editing fields and save behavior (including token count validation and toasts), while updating styling to match the redesigned dashboard via composed shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Label/Switch/Button. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new CreateProjectDialog and ProjectSettingsDialog components into the redesigned dashboard, ensuring existing state, validation, and callbacks are unchanged and that dialog open/close behavior remains correct. Use shadcn-ui Dialog composition through the new components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the redesigned Projects dashboard responsive across breakpoints while keeping existing header/navigation behavior unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, tiles stack cleanly (1 column) and the hero/header typography scales down without overflow or clipping.
On medium/large screens, tiles present as a grid similar to the reference with consistent gaps and alignment.
No changes are required to frontend/src/components/Header.tsx behavior; navigating into/out of projects remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Implement responsive layout rules for the hero and tile grid (1 column on mobile, multi-column grid on tablet/desktop with generous spacing) using Tailwind utilities, ensuring no overflow/clipping and preserving current SPA navigation behavior. Use shadcn-ui components where applicable for consistent interactive states; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust tile internal layout for responsive behavior (typography scaling, truncation, spacing, action button placement) so it remains usable across breakpoints while preserving open/settings/delete interactions. Use shadcn-ui Button focus/hover patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
